message.content:
The `alloc_file_image` only allocates if the pointer is null. So `file_image` isn't reallocated. The use-after-free must come from somewhere else. Let me look at the crash state again: `N_BELE_RTP::LEPolicy::get64` called from `elf_find_table_size` called from `invert_pt_dynamic`. 

In `elf_find_table_size`, the call `get_te64(&dynseg[-1+ x_ndx].d_val)` reads from `dynseg`. The use-after-free means `dynseg` points to freed memory. Let me look at where `dynseg` is set in the context of the crash - line 6826 and 7005 set `dynseg = dyn`. Let me look at those.
